speaker: Doctor
text: The blood work is within normal limits, and the X-ray shows inflammation of the airways without pneumonia. Given the yellow sputum and your recent cold, have you noticed any improvement or worsening of symptoms with your current activities? Also, do you smoke or have any known allergies?

speaker: Doctor
text: That worsening in a dusty environment strongly suggests an irritant-induced component; have you noticed any skin rash, itchy eyes, or nasal congestion when you are at the construction site? Additionally, does the cough wake you up at night or occur specifically in the early morning hours?
